# Replace the mop pad

[All care guides](README.md)

## Roomba e, i and j series, Combo j · Prime robots and other models

**What it does**

A worn pad leaves streaks and picks up less dirt.

**How to**

1. Lift the robot or take it off the dock.
2. Pull the old pad off its holder.
3. Slide or press the new pad onto the holder until it sits.
4. Mark the pad as replaced.

> **Note** Wash washable pads without fabric softener; use disposable pads only once.
